# InstaSaver

> Free online tool to download Instagram videos, reels, photos, and audio (MP3) in original quality. No sign-in required.

## What It Does
- Download Instagram videos and reels as MP4 in original quality
- Extract Instagram reel audio and save as MP3
- Download Instagram photos and carousels in full resolution JPG
- Supports public posts, reels, carousels, and feed videos

## How It Works
1. Copy the Instagram post/reel URL
2. Paste it on the site
3. Download the media file directly

## Key Features
- No account or login required
- Original quality files from Instagram CDN
- Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Free with no download limits
- Supports carousels (multiple slides)
- No files stored on servers
